title: Earn 50% Back On Pro Football Games With Gemini’s New Live Trading Hub
summary: New and existing predictions users on Gemini can earn rewards for trading NFL games from today through the end of Week 1.
body_markdown:
To celebrate the start of the NFL season, Gemini is offering incentives for new and existing Gemini Predictions traders and launching a dedicated trading hub for NFL games. The following promotion runs from today through the end of Week 1.


**New Gemini users can earn 50% back on every trade up to $100.**


- Trade $50, get $25
- Trade $100, get $50
- Trade $500, get $100


**Existing Gemini traders can earn a 50% trade match on up to $50.**


- Trade $50, get $25
- Trade $100, get $50
- Trade $500, get $50


### Introducing the NFL Trading Hub and Live Activities


This season, we're launching a dedicated live hub for trading NFL games, right inside the app. Track lines as they move, jump between games in real time, and manage every position from one place. No more bouncing between apps to keep up with your trades. The hub updates live throughout each game, so you're always trading with the latest data.


Additionally, with a new Live Activities feature, NFL scores will pop up on your phone’s home screen so you can track the game continuously. Now, you can simply click on the widget to re-enter the app and place your next trade.


### New This Season: Prepackaged Combos


We've also built a set of prepackaged combos. These are curated groups of picks bundled together for people who want a themed, ready-to-go way to trade Week 1. Check out the NFL hub to find out what’s on the board for Week 1 but stay tuned for more as the season progresses.


### Ready for Kickoff


Between the Week 1 trade match, the new live NFL hub, and the prepackaged combos, there's never been a better time to jump in. Open the app, head to the hub, and get your Week 1 trades in before kickoff.
